qa: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Cyborg] type trait.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: This card/Digimon is also treated as having the [Cyborg] trait. [On Play][When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: [When Attacking] By trashing 1 card in your hand, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon.
